answer:
You should call `POST http://localhost:11434/api/embed`. It takes a JSON body with a `model` and an `input`. The `input` can be a single string or an array of strings for a batch. The docs show the cURL form: "model": "embeddinggemma", "input": "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]. For batches, "Pass an array of strings to `input`." [ollama/docs/capabilities/embeddings.md]

The API index lists "Generate Embeddings" as an endpoint [ollama/docs/api.md]. The API reference also includes an older-looking form, `/api/embeddings`, which takes `"prompt"` instead of `"input"`: "prompt": "Here is an article about llamas..." [ollama/docs/api.md]. The retrieved context doesn't say whether this endpoint is deprecated, so I can't confirm that. For new code, the `/api/embed` form shown in the embeddings guide is the one the docs use.
